column1: # mtgish cross-check exclusions: the deliberate holes in the comparison.
# One line per exclusion, tab-separated:  kind<TAB>key<TAB>reason
#   kind card:  key is a card name; the card is not compared at all. Excluded
#               cards are counted and listed in the report header.
#   kind token: key is an unmapped:X spelling that is deliberately not mapped
#               Alchemy-only mechanics). A row all of whose unmapped tokens are
#               excluded is class `excluded`: it needs no ledger line, is
#               reported apart and is not counted as a gap.
# Exclude only what really cannot be compared, never what is merely tedious.
# TestMtgishLedger fails on a malformed line, an empty reason, a duplicate, or
# an exclusion that matches nothing live (stale: delete it). Never card text.
